title: Product Photo Lighting Without a Studio | AIVideosUGC
description: Product photo lighting for glass, metal, and gloss. Fix a harsh snapshot with soft, directional light and clean highlights, from one uploaded photo.
h1: Product Photo Lighting for Glass, Metal and Gloss
lead: Product photo lighting starts from one clear photo. Describe the light so glass, metal, and gloss stay easy to see, then start a clip with a voice, captions, or an AI actor.
secondary_keywords: skincare product photo with soft light

steps.d: Upload a sharp photo of the whole product, with the edges that catch light in focus. A plain snapshot is enough.
Name the light direction, how soft the shadow should be, and how glass or metal should look. The result is a square photo.
Download the image and compare its silhouette, color and finish with the real item. Add any offer text in your editor after export.

faq.q: Which products show a useful lighting change?
faq.a: Glass, metal, and gloss. Perfume bottles, jars, watches, steel cups, and chains are typical. Compare every download with the real item.

faq.q: What is product photo lighting here?
faq.a: You upload one clear photo and describe the direction, the shadow, and the surface. Studio lighting for product photos comes back as a square file.

faq.q: Do I need a studio setup?
faq.a: No. A plain snapshot is enough. Name the light you want instead of setting up stands and softboxes.

faq.q: Can I reduce glare on glass or metal?
faq.a: Yes. Ask for softer light or a narrower highlight. Reject a frame that changes the shape or the color.

faq.q: Will the new lighting change the shape or color?
faq.a: It can. Compare the silhouette, the color, and the finish with the real item at full size, and keep only a frame that still matches.

faq.q: Which light suits an Amazon listing?
faq.a: Even light from the front keeps a label area easier to see. A stronger side light is better kept for an ad, not the main listing face.

faq.q: Can the lit photo start a video?
faq.a: Yes. The same photo can start a clip with an AI voice, captions, a script, and an AI actor. Publish that clip to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook in one step.

faq.q: What does a lighting photo cost?
faq.a: Each photo is 24 credits. You see that cost before the job starts, and a failed job returns those credits. Starter is $24.50 a month with 200 credits. The download has no watermark.

faq.q: Can I light several photos at once?
faq.a: Yes. Run the same light note across a batch, or send the catalog through the API. A clip from a lit photo is priced as a video: 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

faq.q: Can I add offer text on the photo?
faq.a: Type the offer in your editor after download. Captions on a clip can name the product, and you can still add a price yourself.

faq.q: Can I use the file in ads?
faq.a: Yes. The square photo and a clip made from it can run in your ads and on your pages. People in a clip are AI actors, so present that clip as your ad.
